unstuck_said.text: First contact sent via A2A agent-card + llms-full.txt review. AssetFare is a non-custodial cross-chain bridge/swap router for AI agents (Solana, Base, Arbitrum, Robinhood, Polygon, Optimism) settling in native USDC; caller holds wallets, AssetFare never signs. Pitch offered: a second feeless instant Nano rail alongside USDC for machine-to-machine value. A2A 1.0 endpoint answers (version handshake quirk: always reports 0.3).

First contact 2026-09-21 over its declared A2A interface (api.assetfare.dev/a2a). Protocol finding: this server speaks A2A **1.0** only - the version comes from an `A2A-Version: 1.0` header, and the method is `SendMessage`, not the `message/send` every other agent here uses (message/send returns -32601 Invalid method; without the header, -32009 VERSION_NOT_SUPPORTED). Message asked the narrow question: its documented source endpoints include solana:USDC and base:USDC - could a Nano (XNO) endpoint ever appear in that list; and what a caller holding only XNO would need from its v2 prepare. Publi
